summary: The basename filter returns the last component of a path; unlike Unix basename, a trailing slash gives an empty string.
questions: How do I get the file name from a path in Ansible?
Why does basename return an empty string for a path ending in a slash?

answer_card.title: basename filter
answer_card.answer_md: `{{ path | basename }}` returns the last path component. Unlike Unix `basename`, `/foo/bar/` returns `''` (empty), not `bar`.
